top_signals.title: City law and accountancy firms face cash flow crunch in HMRC shake-up
top_signals.summary: City partnerships could be forced to take on expensive debt to fund their own partners’ tax bills after the government confirmed a major shake-up of HMRC’s self-assessment regime. As part of the Budget, Chancellor John Healey confirmed the government announced plans to introduce more timely payments for income tax self assessment (ITSA) from April 2029. [...]

top_signals.title: Francophone summit opens with Congo-Rwanda clash
top_signals.summary: The Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) gathers around 90 states and nations including 53 full members.

top_signals.title: Flush with wins, U.S. Democrats confront fear of fleeting success
top_signals.summary: The mood at the What's Next convention veered between jubilation and catharsis after Democrats won commanding majorities in the U.S. House and Senate.
